Game Overview

In Maze Runner Ball, the core idea is straightforward: quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Maze Runner Ball follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Maze Runner Ball?

Maze Runner Ball is a free adventure game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Maze Runner Ball free to play?

Yes, Maze Runner Ball is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
